_about: Pre-registered mapping from B. V. Raman's strength-verdict phrases (HTJAH) onto the engine's 9-grade VERDICT_SCALE. COMMITTED BEFORE ANY SCORING so it cannot be tuned to flatter the engine. Patterns are matched WORD-BOUNDED against the lowercased verdict phrase, MOST-SPECIFIC FIRST (first hit wins). A phrase matching no pattern is 'unmappable' -> excluded from scoring and logged, never guessed.
_bugfix_2026_07_08: Two matcher/vocabulary defects fixed after a forensic pass (see notes): (B1) matching is now WORD-BOUNDED so 'afflicted' no longer matches inside 'unafflicted', and 'unafflicted'/'unsullied'/'well disposed' get their own faithful patterns; (B2) bare 'afflicted' (a subject's verdict) now ranks ABOVE bare 'blemished' (usually another planet's), so 'Venus is afflicted by a blemished Mercury' maps to afflicted, not moderate. Specific '<x> blemished' subject verdicts (feebly/moderately/considerably) are unchanged and still rank first.
_extension_2026_07_12: Map v2 (increment 27). New stems recovered from the grow2/grow3 culls, each grade derived BLIND from the map's own intensity ladder (no engine output consulted; rationale per family in notes). Also fixes a negation bug on the 'disposed' family: 'not well disposed' matched the positive 'well disposed' -> TWO shipped rows re-grade fairly good -> weak (omar H7 bhava, hyderali H5 karaka — the only deliberate re-grades; every other shipped phrase grades identically under v1 and v2, pinned by test_verdict_map_v2).

notes.feebly: 'feebly weak' / 'feebly strong' both denote a barely-present strength -> weak (1).
notes.quite strong: Raman's 'quite strong[ly]' sits just under 'fairly powerful' -> fairly strong (5).
notes.inclining towards good: a tentative positive, below a settled 'good' -> moderate (2).
notes.unafflicted: mere absence of affliction (often qualified, e.g. 'otherwise unafflicted ... not desirable') -> a neutral-positive baseline, moderate (2). Distinct from the stronger 'not afflicted' -> fairly good.
notes.bare roots: bare 'strong'/'powerful'/'good' WITHOUT an intensifier are intentionally NOT mapped (too ambiguous) -> unmappable/excluded.
notes.v2 negation family: 'not well disposed' / 'ill-disposed' mirror the existing negation precedent ('not afflicted' before 'afflicted'); a negated positive is a settled deficiency -> weak (1), one step above afflicted since Raman reserves 'afflicted' for active harm.
notes.v2 fortified family: 'fortified' is Raman's strongest positive verb family, above 'disposed'. Bare-intensified forms (highly/fully/immensely/considerably/strongly fortified) -> very strong (7), mirroring 'very strong'; the mild 'well fortified' -> fairly strong (5), one step over 'well disposed'.
notes.v2 affliction-freedom: 'free from (any) affliction' is an emphatic absence-of-harm, equivalent to 'not afflicted' -> fairly good (4).
notes.v2 placement family: 'well placed' parallels 'well disposed' -> fairly good (4); 'ideally placed' carries a strong intensifier -> fairly strong (5), kept conservative (not 'very strong': placement is weaker testimony than fortification).
notes.v2 power family: 'exceptionally powerful' joins the 'very powerful' top band (8); 'highly powerful' and 'strong par excellence' -> very strong (7), mirroring 'very strongly'.
notes.v2 destruction family: 'null and void' is total negation of a house's promise -> afflicted (0); 'has no strength' is a flat strength denial -> weak (1).
